Name: Simple Auto Fisher (1.6 Optimized)1.0.1
Author: 66rayyan99
Description:
[heading]🎣 Auto Fishing (1.6 Optimized)[/heading]
Tired of the stressful fishing mini-game in Stardew Valley? This mod is designed to make your fishing experience effortless and productive!
[b]✨ Main Features:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Auto-Hook:[/b] The mod automatically hooks the fish as soon as it bites.[/*]
[*][b]Auto-Catch:[/b] Skips the mini-game entirely and catches the fish instantly.[/*]
[*][b]Treasure Hunter:[/b] Automatically collects any treasure chests that appear while fishing.[/*]
[*][b]1.6 Ready:[/b] Fully compatible with the latest Stardew Valley update.[/*]
[/list][b]🔧 How to Install:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the folder.[/*]
[*]Place the folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Run the game and start fishing![/*]
[/list][b]💡 Why use this mod?[/b]
This is perfect for players who want to focus on farm management and exploration without spending hours on the fishing mini-game. It’s lightweight and won't affect your game performance.

Manifest.Name: Instant Fish Catch Pro
Manifest.Description: Instantly catch any fish. Optimized for Stardew Valley 1.6 and .NET 10.
